title: 听出方案调整的原因
source: LearnLoop 自编短练 · 合成语音 · 非六级真题，难度未校准
prompt: 先听一段校园通知，再回答：Why will the library open earlier instead of closing later?
speech_text: The university library considered staying open until midnight during the examination period. However, a student survey showed that most students preferred to study before their morning classes. The library will therefore open at seven instead of eight, while its evening closing time will remain unchanged. The new schedule will be tested for two weeks. Staff will record how many students arrive early before deciding whether to keep it.
options: Students asked for more study time in the morning.
The library cannot afford to keep the lights on.
All evening classes have been cancelled.
The library will be closed during examinations.
reference: 答案 A。转折后说学生更喜欢早课前学习，因此提前一小时开馆；晚上闭馆时间不变。听辨重点：however / preferred / therefore / remain unchanged。
checklist: 我听到了偏好的时间段，而不只是 midnight。
我能说明 however 前后方案的差别。
我已隐藏文字，重新听出关键句。

title: 区分观察与因果结论
source: LearnLoop 自编短练 · 合成语音 · 非六级真题，难度未校准
prompt: 先听研究介绍，再回答：What does the speaker recommend doing next?
speech_text: Our first survey found that students who used the study room regularly reported less stress. This does not necessarily mean that the room reduced their stress. These students may already have had more stable study routines. We plan to compare two groups with similar routines over a longer period. That will help us understand whether access to the room makes a difference.
options: Compare similar groups over a longer period.
Claim that the room has already solved stress.
Ask only the students who feel relaxed.
reference: 答案 B。已有调查发现相关性，但不能排除学习习惯的影响，所以要比较习惯相似的组并延长观察。
checklist: 我听清了 does not necessarily mean 的限制。
我能复述下一步比较什么、观察多久。
我已不看文本重听计划部分。

title: 用具体例子支撑观点
source: LearnLoop 自编练习 · 非六级真题，难度未校准
prompt: Write an essay on how university students can contribute to their local communities. State your position and support it with a specific example. Aim for 150–200 words; if you are building your foundation, start with one complete paragraph.
reference: 先检查观点是否回应“大学生能怎样贡献社区”。一个可行结构是：明确一种行动 → 说明它解决什么具体问题 → 给出行动过程或例子 → 解释为什么有效及其限制。无需照搬范文；具体例子要服务于观点。
checklist: 观点回应了题目，没有只泛谈大学生活。
至少一个例子有具体行动和结果。
检查了主谓一致、时态与指代。
修改稿保留自己的观点，并说明一处修改原因。

title: 比较两种学习安排
source: LearnLoop 自编练习 · 非六级真题，难度未校准
prompt: Some students prefer studying alone, while others prefer studying in a group. Discuss when each approach may be useful and explain your own choice. Aim for 150–200 words, or begin with a short comparison paragraph.
reference: 比较需要相同维度：任务类型、得到反馈的机会、注意力管理。避免把所有独学或小组学习一概而论。自己的选择应有适用条件和具体理由。
checklist: 两种安排都被公平地描述。
比较围绕相同维度，并提供了例子。
自己的选择有明确条件。
修改了至少一处模糊表达。

title: 先保留信息，再调整表达
source: LearnLoop 自编练习 · 非六级真题，参考译文不是唯一答案
prompt:
把下面短段译成英语：
近年来，许多城市的公共图书馆开始延长开放时间，并为居民提供免费的阅读活动。除了借阅图书，人们还可以在这里参加讲座、学习数字技能。图书馆逐渐成为社区交流和终身学习的重要场所。
reference:
自编参考译文：In recent years, public libraries in many cities have extended their opening hours and offered free reading activities to residents. In addition to borrowing books, people can attend lectures and learn digital skills there. Libraries are gradually becoming important places for community interaction and lifelong learning.
先核对“许多城市”“免费”“除借书以外”的信息是否保留；时态和连接方式允许多种合理表达。
checklist: 没有遗漏时间、范围和免费的限制。
各句都有清楚的主干。
借书、讲座和数字技能的关系清楚。
修改稿改善了一处表达，并保留原稿。

title: 准确表达条件与目的
source: LearnLoop 自编练习 · 非六级真题，参考译文不是唯一答案
prompt:
把下面短段译成英语：
为鼓励绿色出行，一些城市在地铁站附近设置了共享自行车停放点。乘客可以骑车完成出行的最后一段路程。然而，只有当自行车得到及时维护、停放秩序得到改善时，这种服务才能长期便利居民。
reference:
自编参考译文：To encourage environmentally friendly travel, some cities have set up shared bicycle parking areas near subway stations. Passengers can cycle the last part of their journey. However, this service can benefit residents in the long term only if the bicycles are maintained promptly and parking is better organized.
重点是保留“部分城市”“目的”“只有……才……”；不要把条件译成已经发生的事实。
checklist: 目的和条件没有混为一谈。
some cities 的范围没有扩大。
only if 的条件关系准确。
重写后信息完整，表达自然。
